title: Philostratus, Heroicus (Ἡρωικός) / Флавий Филострат, Героик
author: Flavius Philostratus
edition: de Lannoy, Teubner 1977. Public domain: Kayser, Teubner 1870–71 (archive.org).
ru_evidence: Russian Wikipedia 'Флавий Филострат' lists Russian versions of the Life of Apollonius, Gymnasticus (2021, 2022), Imagines, Lives of the Sophists and Letters, but not the Heroicus.
en_evidence: Maclean & Aitken, Flavius Philostratus: Heroikos (SBL 2001); Rusten & König, Loeb (2014). Both cited from memory and not re-checked online this session.
other_translations: German, French and Italian versions exist (not re-verified).
value: A vinedresser and a Phoenician discuss the cult of Protesilaus and a 'corrected' Trojan War against Homer. Key for hero cult, Homer reception, Dictys/Dares-type revisionism and Second Sophistic Hellenism. Widely taught.
ai_feasibility: High. Readable dialogue prose; the many heroic-cult realia need commentary, which existing literature supports well.
pilot_unit: Opening frame and the Protesilaus section (first third), estimated about 7,000 words.
